component.name: osbx
component.summary: Open-source microVM sandbox runtime for coding agents

description.p: osbx runs coding agents inside lightweight KVM microVMs driven by its own VMM, with deny-by-default egress through a host-side policy proxy that injects credentials the sandbox never sees. Kit v3 descriptors add tools, network rules, credentials, persistent storage, host mounts, SSH agent forwarding, lifecycle hooks, and nested KVM access.
